```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(broom)
library(lmerTest)
library(plotrix)
library(gtools)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)
library(mediation)
library(afex)
library(effsize)
library(bwrappers)
library(apa)
afex_options(emmeans_model = "multivariate")
```

```{r}
# Import data
col_names <- names(read_csv(here("data", "disagreement_exp1_raw_data.csv")))
raw_data <- read_csv(here("data", "disagreement_exp1_raw_data.csv"), 
                     col_names = col_names, skip = 3)
```

```{r}
# Filter out incomplete (or preview) responses, and rename some variable
disagree_data <- raw_data %>%
  filter(Finished == 1, Status == 0, !is.na(pol_orient)) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition),
         topic = factor(topic),
         composite = (enjoy + (10 - awk) + learn + (10 - hostile)) / 4,
         pol_orient_group = fct_recode(factor(pol_orient),
                                      "liberal" = "-3",
                                      "liberal" = "-2",
                                      "liberal" = "-1",
                                      "independent" = "0",
                                      "conservative" = "1",
                                      "conservative" = "2",
                                      "conservative" = "3"))
```

```{r}
# Plotting function for prediction DVs
plot <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(!!enquo(dv)),
              lower = mean(!!enquo(dv)) - std.error(!!enquo(dv)),
              upper = mean(!!enquo(dv)) + std.error(!!enquo(dv))) %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = condition, y = mean)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black", fill = "rosybrown2") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = .4, position = position_dodge(1)) +
    theme_classic()
}

plot_topics <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
    group_by(condition, topic) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(!!enquo(dv)),
              lower = mean(!!enquo(dv)) - std.error(!!enquo(dv)),
              upper = mean(!!enquo(dv)) + std.error(!!enquo(dv))) %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = condition, y = mean, fill = topic)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black",) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = .4, position = position_dodge(1))  +
    theme_classic()
}

plot_topics_paired <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
    group_by(condition, topic) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(!!enquo(dv)),
              lower = mean(!!enquo(dv)) - std.error(!!enquo(dv)),
              upper = mean(!!enquo(dv)) + std.error(!!enquo(dv))) %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = topic, y = mean, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black",) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = .4, position = position_dodge(1))  +
    theme_classic()
}

plot_orient <- function(data, dv) {
  data %>%
    group_by(condition, pol_orient_group) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(!!enquo(dv)),
              lower = mean(!!enquo(dv)) - std.error(!!enquo(dv)),
              upper = mean(!!enquo(dv)) + std.error(!!enquo(dv))) %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = condition, y = mean, fill = pol_orient_group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(1), color = "black",) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = .4, position = position_dodge(1))  +
    theme_classic()
}
```

# Alpha for Composite

```{r}
alpha_composite <- psych::alpha(data.frame(disagree_data$enjoy, (10 - disagree_data$awk),
                                                disagree_data$learn, (10 - disagree_data$hostile))) %>%
  summary() %>%
  kable(caption = "Alpha for Composite")
```

\newpage

# Manipulation Check (Similarity Question)

```{r}
plot(disagree_data, similar)
```

```{r}
disagree_data %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = round(mean(similar),2),
                   sd = round(sd(similar),2))
```

```{r}
plot_topics(disagree_data, similar)
```

```{r}
similar_anova <- aov_car(similar ~ condition * topic + Error(ResponseId), 
                              data = disagree_data)
anova_apa(similar_anova, print = FALSE) %>%
  kable()
```


```{r}
table <- disagree_data %>%
  group_by(condition, topic) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean = round(mean(similar),2)) 

topic_order <- c("church", "BLM", "climate", "abortion", "same_sex", "family", "gun",
                                   "restrict", "god")

table[order(match(table$topic, topic_order)),]
```

## Simple Effects by Topic

```{r}
pairs(emmeans(similar_anova, "condition", by = "topic")) %>%
  kable()
```


```{r}
emmeans::eff_size(emmeans(lm(similar ~ condition * topic, data = disagree_data), 
                          "condition", by = "topic"), 
         sigma = stats::sigma(lm(similar ~ condition * topic, data = disagree_data)),
                       edf = stats::df.residual(lm(similar ~ condition * topic, data = disagree_data))) %>%
  #dplyr::select(-SE, -lower.CL, -upper.CL) %>%
  kable(caption = "Effect Sizes", digits = 2)
```

\newpage

# Mediation

```{r}
# Manip on mediator
regXM <- lm(composite ~ condition, data = disagree_data)
# Full model
regXMY <- lm(discuss ~ composite + condition, data = disagree_data)

mediation_results <- mediate(regXM, regXMY, treat='condition', mediator='composite',
                            control.value = 'agree',
                            treat.value = 'disagree',
                             boot=TRUE, sims = 5000)
summary(mediation_results)
```

# Political Orientation

## Counts

```{r}
disagree_data %>%
  group_by(pol_orient) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(count = n(),
                   percent = round((count/nrow(disagree_data)) * 100, digits = 2)) %>%
  kable()
```


## Not reported: Analyses with Political Orientation

*Three-way interaction with political orientation (liberal vs. conservative vs. independent)*

```{r}
composite_orient_anova <- aov_car(composite ~ condition * topic * pol_orient_group + Error(ResponseId), 
                              data = disagree_data)
anova_apa(composite_orient_anova, print = FALSE) %>%
  kable()
```

*Two-way interaction between condition and political orientation (liberal vs. conservative vs. independent)*

```{r}
composite_orient_anova <- aov_car(composite ~ condition * pol_orient_group + Error(ResponseId), 
                              data = disagree_data)
anova_apa(composite_orient_anova, print = FALSE) %>%
  kable()
```

```{r}
plot_orient(disagree_data, composite)
```

```{r}
# Gender Breakdown
gender_table <- disagree_data %>%
  group_by(male) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(proportion = n() / nrow(disagree_data))

row_names <- c("Female", "Male", "Other") %>%
 data.frame()

bind_cols(row_names, gender_table) %>%
  dplyr::select(-male) %>%
kable(digits = 4, caption = "Gender Breakdown")
```

```{r}

ethnicity_table <- disagree_data %>%
  #dplyr::select(race_wh5_5)
  group_by(race_5) %>%
```
